content: Gɑri wee, yi yi kɑ Yerusɑlɛmun wɔwɑ yɑ̃ mi bɑ rɑ kɑ̃si.

content.text: Wunɛ Yerusɑlɛmu, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ wunɛn tɔmbɑ nuku dobu mɔ̀,
mɑ bɑ kuuki mɔ̀.
Mbɑ n kuɑ bɑ kɑ yɔɔmɔ dii tɛɛri wɔllɔ.
Wunɛn tɔn be bɑ mɛɛrɑ kuɑ, bɑ ǹ bu mɛɛrɑ kue tɑbu sɔɔ,
bɑ ǹ mɑɑ ɡu kɑ tɑkobi.
Wee wunɛn tɑbu sinɑmbu kɑ wunɛn tɔmbu kpuro
bɑ duki yɑrinɑ n tomɑ,
mɑ tɛn towobu bɑ bu mwɛɛrɑ bɑ kuɑ yobu.
Yen sɔ̃, nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, i ɡɛsiro nɛn bɔkun di,
i mɑn derio n swĩ.
I ku tii nɔwiɑ ko i nɛɛ,
i ko i mɑn nukuru yɛmiɑsiɑ
nɛn tɔmbun nɔni swɑ̃ɑrun sɔ̃.
Tɔ̃ɔ teni sɔɔ, Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni
u derɑ sɑ nɔni sɔ̃ɔre, sɑ burisinɛ,
sɑ wɑ̃ɑ biti sɔɔ wɔwɑ yeni sɔɔ mi bɑ rɑ kɑ̃si.
Bɑ ɡɑni kɔsukumɔ mɑ sɑ nɔɔɡiru sue
sɑ fɑɑbɑ kɑnɑmɔ ɡuunun berɑ ɡiɑ.
Elɑmun tɑbu kowobu bɑ wee
bɑ wɑ̃ɑ tɑbu kɛkɛbɑ sɔɔ kɑ mɑɑsɔbu,
mɑ bɑ sɛ̃ɛ bwɑ̃ɑnu bɛki.
Kiriɡibu bɑ mɑɑ wee, bɑ tɛrɛnu nɛni.
Wunɛ Yerusɑlɛmu, wee tɑbu kɛkɛbɑ bɑ tɛrie
wunɛn wɔwi sɔɔ mi tem ɡem wɑ̃ɑ.
Mɑ mɑɑsɔbu bɑ wunɛn ɡbɑ̃rɑ kɔnnɔsu tɑrusi.
Bɛɛ Yudɑbɑ i ǹ mɑɑ tɑ̃si yeru mɔ.
Tɔ̃ɔ te, i mɛɛrɑ mi i rɑ bɛɛn tɑbu yɑ̃nu bere
dii te bɑ mɔ̀ Dɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔwɔ.
Mɑ i deemɑ bɑ bɛɛn wuu Yerusɑlɛmun ɡbɑ̃rɑru yɑburɑ.
Yerɑ i diɑ mɛɛrɑ mɛɛrɑ i kɔsukɑ
i kɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ te sɔnwɑ.
Mɑ i nim torɑ ye bɑ rɑɑ ɡbɑn nim yɔ̃rɑsiɑ wuu sɔɔ.
I kpɑɑ ɡbɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑnu yirun bɑɑ sɔɔ
yu kɑ yeɔnɔn nim nɛnɛ.
Adɑmɑ i ǹ Gusunɔ mɛɛrɑ
wi u yen himbɑ yi yellun di.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ tɔ̃ɔ teni sɔɔ,
Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni, u bɛɛ sokɑ i kɑ swĩ,
kpɑ i weeweenu ko i bɛɛn winu kɔni,
kpɑ i sɑɑkibɑ dewe nuku sɑnkirɑnun sɔ̃.
Adɑmɑ wee i nuku dobu mɔ̀ i yɛ̃ɛrimɔ.
I kɛtɛbɑ kɑ yɑ̃ɑnu ɡoomɔ.
I yɑɑ temmɔ mɑ i tɑm nɔrumɔ i mɔ̀,
su di kpɑ su nɔ, domi siɑ sɑ ko ɡbi.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni
u mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
u ǹ bɛɛ bɛɛn durum yeni wɔkɑmmɛ
sere i kɑ ɡbi.

content: Amɛniwɑ Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni, u mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɑ. U nɛɛ, n doo n Sebinɑ wi u sɑ̃ɑ sinɑ kpɑɑrun sɔm kowobun wiruɡii sɔ̃ n nɛɛ,

content.text: mbɑ u mɔ̀ mi.
Wɑrɑ u mɔ mi u kɑ tii siki wɔru dɑ̃kuɑmmɛ kperɔ.
Wee wi, Yinni Gusunɔ u koo nùn bɔke nɡe kureru
kpɑ u nùn kɑsɑ kɔ̃ kɑ dɑm,
kpɑ u n bindimɔ nɡe bɑnɔ bɑtumɑ bɑkɑ sɔɔ.
Miyɑ u koo ɡbi kɑ win tɑbu kɛkɛ sisuɡii yi u nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ,
wi, wi u win yinnin yɛnu sekuru doke.
Wi, Yinni Gusunɔ, u koo nùn yɑrɑ win sɔmburun di
kpɑ u kun mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡoo.
Yen tɔ̃ɔ te, wi Yinni Gusunɔ,
u koo win sɔm kowo Eliɑkimu, Hilikiyɑn bii soku,
kpɑ u nùn wi, Sebinɑn yɑberu sebusiɑ
kpɑ u nùn win kpɑkɑ sɛ̃ke
kpɑ u nùn win dɑm wɛ̃.
Eliɑkimu wi, u ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu kɑ Yudɑbɑn bɑɑbɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u koo nùn Dɑfidin yɛnun kɔkɔrɔ wɛ̃.
Ù n kɛniɑ, ɡoo kun kɛnumɔ.
Ù n mɑɑ kɛnuɑ, ɡoo kun kɛniɑmɔ.
U koo nùn ɡirɑwɑ nɡe sɑsɑru
mi n nɑɑnɛ mɔ,
kpɑ u de win tundon yɛnu ɡɑ n bɛɛrɛ mɔ.

content: U ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ bɛɛrɛ yen wiru. Be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ win yɛnuɔ, bukurobu kɑ bibu, ɡobiɡibu kɑ sɑ̃ɑrobu, wiyɑ u ko n be kpuro sɔɔwɑ nɡe sɑsɑru.

Adɑmɑ Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni, u mɑɑ nɛɛ, sɔ̃ɔ teeru bɑ koo sɑsɑ te wukɑ te bɑ rɑɑ ɡirɑ mi n nɑɑnɛ mɔ mi, kpɑ tu wɔrumɑ tu bɔɔrɑ, kpɑ sɔmu ni tɑ rɑɑ sɔɔwɑ mi, nu kɑm ko. Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u yeni ɡeruɑ.
